passive.name: Pit Grit
passive.text: Sett's basic attacks alternate between left and right punch. Right punch is slightly stronger and faster. Sett also hates losing, gaining additional health regeneration based off of his missing health.

spells.name: Knuckle Down
spells.text: Sett's next two attacks deal additional damage based off of the target's max health. Sett also gains Move Speed while moving towards enemy champions.

spells.name: Haymaker
spells.text: Sett passively stores damage he takes as Grit. On cast, Sett expends all stored Grit to gain a shield and punch an area, dealing true damage in the center and physical damage on the sides.

spells.name: Facebreaker
spells.text: Sett pulls in all enemies on opposite sides of him, dealing damage and stunning them. If enemies were only on one side, they are slowed instead of stunned.

spells.name: The Show Stopper
spells.text: Sett carries an enemy champion through the air and slams them into the ground, dealing damage and slowing all enemies near where they land.

damage.value: Sett deals burst true damage at the center of Haymaker and physical damage on its sides.

archetype.value: Sett is a bruiser who absorbs damage as Grit, shields himself, and fights with punches and close-range control.

axis.value: Sett can use his right punch for extra range while CSing, then commit to a fight after removing Bone Plating when it is present.

spikes.why: Sett is harder to dive when his CC and shield are available.
Sett can improve his late-game 1v1 ability, but becomes squishier in teamfights.

spikes.at: Q cooldown falls from 9 to 5 seconds
spikes.why: Sett can use Knuckle Down’s empowered attacks more often.

bait.why: Sett loses a small movement boost while Q is spent, making his limited mobility easier to exploit.

mistakes.value: Sett becomes squishier in teamfights if he prioritizes 1v1 items to offset his late-game decline.
